scope: Source staging only; game project unchanged by audio sourcing task.
license_summary: All downloaded selected sources are offered as CC0-1.0 on inspected author/publisher asset pages. Commercial use and modifications permitted; no mandatory attribution stated. Retain courtesy credits and provenance.
audition_status: Files are technically decoded/probed and author descriptions inspected. This sourcing pass does not claim a human headphone audition; final subjective mix remains a listening QA task.

sources.title: Casino Audio 1.1
sources.author: Kenney Vleugels / Kenney
sources.notes: Paper card handling: use slide, place, fan, shove, shuffle; chip sounds are secondary inventory candidates.

sources.title: RPG Audio
sources.author: Kenney Vleugels / Kenney
sources.notes: Physical book, leather, coins, door, creak and footsteps. Prefer these organic cues to electronic UI effects.

sources.title: Interface Sounds 1.0
sources.author: Kenney
sources.notes: Restrained click/tick/pluck/toggle/back/confirmation choices; avoid glitch and loud error variants for this art direction.

sources.title: Medieval: The Bard's Tale

sources.notes: Author-supplied looping peaceful medieval lute/flute instrumental. Suggested day gameplay theme.

sources.title: Medieval: The Old Tower Inn
sources.author: RandomMind
sources.notes: Author-supplied looping medieval instrumental. Suggested menu/shop theme.

sources.title: Forest Ambience

sources.title: Ambient Bird Sounds

sources.title: Crickets Ambient Noise - loopable

sources.title: Fire Crackling
sources.author: AntumDeluge
sources.notes: Short 2.87-second mono fireplace crackle. Optional quiet interior texture; its repetition may be noticeable.

sources.title: Park ambiences
sources.author: Thimras
sources.notes: Natural field recordings of small river/wildlife and open-field wind in Adelaide. Wind is filtered and attenuated in derivatives; river should be used only where water fits the scene.

derived_files.modifications: Author-supplied loop duration preserved exactly at output sample rate; resampled 48kHz stereo; normalized toward -20dBFS RMS with -3.5dBFS source peak ceiling; 12ms raised-cosine fade-in/out de-click at endpoints; OGG Vorbis quality 5. No overlap or shortening, so musical meter is preserved.
